zoom_note: zoom 2 = the shot is authored at 320x180 and drawn at 2x (camera zoom). The 32x32 pack has every image at 2x.
skippable: hold SPACE (ui_skip_prompt fills over ~1 s), jumps to s11

shots.name: Title card
shots.notes: fade in from black 800 ms, hold, fade out 500 ms. Music: soft processional starts.

shots.name: Wide - commencement on the quad
shots.notes: static wide shot; caption from 0.8 s; the audience claps for the last 2 s (swap clap0/clap1 every 200 ms); 2-3 random camera flashes in the family rows.

shots.name: Medium - the dean at the podium

caption.speaker: DEAN MARLOWE
lines: And now, the moment you've all been
waiting for: the conferring of degrees.

shots.notes: dean behind the podium, speaking loop while the caption types out.

shots.name: Medium - name called, walk across the stage
shots.notes: graduate walks in from the left (≈ 60 px/s at 320 scale) to the dean; name card slides in at 1.0 s, out at 4.0 s; dean steps out and holds out the diploma.

shots.name: Close-up - handshake + diploma
shots.notes: 6 frames at 300 ms then hold; camera flash on frame 3 (the photo the family takes).

shots.name: Close-up - the diploma
shots.notes: hold; the engine writes the player's name into the [PLAYER NAME] gap (or redraw the text layer).

shots.name: Close-up - turning the tassel
shots.notes: 6 frames at 260 ms, tassel moves from right to left; small sparkle on the last frame.

shots.name: Medium - congratulations
shots.notes: graduate turns to the camera holding the diploma; dean's line.

shots.name: Cap toss
shots.notes: cheer row frame 0 (caps on) 400 ms, frame 1 (throw) 300 ms, then alternate 2/3 every 200 ms; caps overlay 12 frames at 300 ms; confetti tiled over the top. Music swells.

shots.name: Snapshot - polaroid
shots.notes: white flash, then the cap toss freezes into the polaroid. The photo becomes the 'graduation_photo' keepsake item.

shots.name: Iris out + chapter card
shots.notes: iris closes on the polaroid (8 frames x 80 ms), chapter card fades in; gameplay starts with the bus pulling into town.
